name: Steak Sandwich with Mustard Mayo & Onions
description: Thinly sliced steak in toasted ciabatta with mustard mayo, soft onions and salad leaves. An optional leftover-steak swap makes it a quick lunch.
instructions: Thinly slice half an onion. Cook it in 1 tsp olive oil over medium-low heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden. Set aside.

Season the steak with salt and black pepper. Heat the pan until hot and sear the steak for 2–3 minutes per side, adjusting for thickness and preferred doneness. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
Mix 1 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Split and toast the ciabatta roll, then spread the mustard mayo on both cut sides.
Layer in the salad leaves, warm onions and sliced steak. Add any resting juices, close the sandwich and serve straight away.

substitutions.label: Use leftover cooked steak
substitutions.note: Use about 150–180 g of cooked steak kept refrigerated. Skip the steak-cooking step: slice it thinly against the grain and add it cold, or warm it briefly and gently in the pan after cooking the onions. Do not sear it again.
